```python
from html.parser import HTMLParser

VOID = {'br','hr','img','input','meta','link'}

class Node:
    def __init__(self, tag=None, attrs=None, text=None):
        self.tag=tag; self.attrs=attrs or {}; self.children=[]; self.text=text

class Dom(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.root=Node('root'); self.stack=[self.root]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        n=Node(tag, dict(attrs)); self.stack[-1].children.append(n)
        if tag not in VOID: self.stack.append(n)
    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):
        self.stack[-1].children.append(Node(tag, dict(attrs)))
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        for i in range(len(self.stack)-1, 0, -1):
            if self.stack[i].tag==tag:
                del self.stack[i:]; break
    def handle_data(self, data):
        self.stack[-1].children.append(Node(text=data))
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""把 docs/<name>.md 转成排版正常的 Word（.docx）。

为什么不用 soffice：老的流水线是 md -> HTML(带 CSS) -> odt -> docx，
CSS 那套样式映射不进 Word，转换时全丢，出来的 docx 就是 LibreOffice 默认样子
（字体不对、表格没框、标题层级平掉）。这里改成 md -> HTML -> 自己走 Word 的
样式系统写，字体 / 标题层级 / 表格边框 / 代码块底纹都是显式设的。

用法：
    python3 md2docx.py 技术报告 [作品介绍 ...]
"""

import sys
import os
import re
from html.parser import HTMLParser

import markdown
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Cm, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

DOCS = "/home/ubuntu/contest2026_086_ditiekouyegoulianmeng/docs"

# 字体：中文走 eastAsia，西文走 ascii/hAnsi
FONT_ASCII = "Times New Roman"
FONT_CJK = "宋体"
FONT_CJK_HEAD = "微软雅黑"
FONT_MONO = "Consolas"
FONT_MONO_CJK = "宋体"

CODE_FILL = "F2F2F2"      # 代码块底纹
TH_FILL = "D9E2F3"        # 表头底纹
QUOTE_COLOR = RGBColor(0x44, 0x44, 0x44)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- HTML 解析

VOID = {"br", "hr", "img", "input", "meta", "link", "col"}


class Node:
    __slots__ = ("tag", "attrs", "children", "text")

    def __init__(self, tag=None, attrs=None, text=None):
        self.tag = tag
        self.attrs = attrs or {}
        self.children = []
        self.text = text


class Dom(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.root = Node("root")
        self.stack = [self.root]

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        n = Node(tag, dict(attrs))
        self.stack[-1].children.append(n)
        if tag not in VOID:
            self.stack.append(n)

    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):
        self.stack[-1].children.append(Node(tag, dict(attrs)))

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        for i in range(len(self.stack) - 1, 0, -1):
            if self.stack[i].tag == tag:
                del self.stack[i:]
                return

    def handle_data(self, data):
        self.stack[-1].children.append(Node(text=data))


# ------------------------------------------------------------ 底层 XML 工具

def set_run_font(run, ascii_font=FONT_ASCII, cjk_font=FONT_CJK, size=None,
                 bold=None, italic=None, color=None):
    run.font.name = ascii_font
    if size is not None:
        run.font.size = size
    if bold is not None:
        run.font.bold = bold
    if italic is not None:
        run.font.italic = italic
    if color is not None:
        run.font.color.rgb = color
    rpr = run._element.get_or_add_rPr()
    rf = rpr.get_or_add_rFonts()
    rf.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), cjk_font)
    rf.set(qn("w:ascii"), ascii_font)
    rf.set(qn("w:hAnsi"), ascii_font)


def shade(element_holder, fill):
    """给 run 的 rPr 或 cell 的 tcPr 加底纹。"""
    el = element_holder
    pr = el.get_or_add_rPr() if hasattr(el, "get_or_add_rPr") else None
    if pr is None:
        return
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), fill)
    pr.append(shd)


def cell_shade(cell, fill):
    tcpr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), fill)
    tcpr.append(shd)


def para_bottom_border(p, size=6, color="888888"):
    ppr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    bdr = OxmlElement("w:pBdr")
    bottom = OxmlElement("w:bottom")
    bottom.set(qn("w:val"), "single")
    bottom.set(qn("w:sz"), str(size))
    bottom.set(qn("w:space"), "1")
    bottom.set(qn("w:color"), color)
    bdr.append(bottom)
    ppr.append(bdr)


def table_borders(table, color="7F7F7F", sz=4):
    tbl_pr = table._tbl.tblPr
    borders = OxmlElement("w:tblBorders")
    for edge in ("top", "left", "bottom", "right", "insideH", "insideV"):
        e = OxmlElement("w:" + edge)
        e.set(qn("w:val"), "single")
        e.set(qn("w:sz"), str(sz))
        e.set(qn("w:space"), "0")
        e.set(qn("w:color"), color)
        borders.append(e)
    tbl_pr.append(borders)


def keep_lines(p):
    ppr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    ppr.append(OxmlElement("w:keepLines"))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 行内解析

def collect_inline(node, bold=False, italic=False, code=False, out=None):
    """把一段 HTML 拍平成 [(文本, 粗, 斜, 等宽)]。"""
    if out is None:
        out = []
    for c in node.children:
        if c.tag is None:
            if c.text:
                out.append((c.text, bold, italic, code))
        elif c.tag in ("strong", "b"):
            collect_inline(c, True, italic, code, out)
        elif c.tag in ("em", "i"):
            collect_inline(c, bold, True, code, out)
        elif c.tag == "code":
            collect_inline(c, bold, italic, True, out)
        elif c.tag == "br":
            out.append(("\n", bold, italic, code))
        else:
            collect_inline(c, bold, italic, code, out)
    return out


def add_inline(paragraph, node, size=Pt(10.5), base_bold=None):
    runs = collect_inline(node)
    # 合并相邻同样式片段，少生成 run
    merged = []
    for text, b, i, c in runs:
        if merged and merged[-1][1:] == (b, i, c):
            merged[-1] = (merged[-1][0] + text, b, i, c)
        else:
            merged.append((text, b, i, c))
    for text, b, i, c in merged:
        text = re.sub(r"[ \t]*\n[ \t]*", " ", text)
        if not text:
            continue
        run = paragraph.add_run(text)
        if c:
            set_run_font(run, FONT_MONO, FONT_MONO_CJK, size=Pt(size.pt - 0.5),
                         bold=b, italic=i)
            shade(run._element, CODE_FILL)
        else:
            set_run_font(run, FONT_ASCII, FONT_CJK, size=size,
                         bold=(True if base_bold else b), italic=i)
    return runs


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 块级输出

def add_heading(doc, node, level):
    # md 的 #### 会在 HTML 里变成 h4；Word 标题层级从 1 起
    text = "".join(t for t, *_ in collect_inline(node)).strip()
    if not text:
        return
    if level == 1:
        p = doc.add_paragraph()
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
        p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(0)
        p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(18)
        r = p.add_run(text)
        set_run_font(r, FONT_CJK_HEAD, FONT_CJK_HEAD, size=Pt(20), bold=True)
        return
    sizes = {2: 15, 3: 13, 4: 11.5, 5: 11, 6: 10.5}
    size = Pt(sizes.get(level, 10.5))
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(14 if level == 2 else 10)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
    keep_lines(p)
    r = p.add_run(text)
    set_run_font(r, FONT_CJK_HEAD, FONT_CJK_HEAD, size=size, bold=True,
                 color=RGBColor(0x1F, 0x38, 0x64) if level == 2 else None)
    # 让标题进 Word 的导航窗格 / 目录，仍挂内置 Heading 样式
    try:
        p.style = doc.styles["Heading %d" % min(level - 1, 9)]
        for run in p.runs:  # style 会覆盖字体，重设一遍
            set_run_font(run, FONT_CJK_HEAD, FONT_CJK_HEAD, size=size, bold=True,
                         color=RGBColor(0x1F, 0x38, 0x64) if level == 2 else None)
    except KeyError:
        pass


def add_paragraph(doc, node):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
    p.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.4
    add_inline(p, node)
    return p


def add_list(doc, node, ordered, level=0):
    style = ("List Number" if ordered else "List Bullet") + (" %d" % (level + 1) if level else "")
    for li in [c for c in node.children if c.tag == "li"]:
        # li 里的 p 拆出来；嵌套 list 递归
        nested = [c for c in li.children if c.tag in ("ul", "ol")]
        inline_src = Node("li")
        inline_src.children = [c for c in li.children if c.tag not in ("ul", "ol")]
        p = doc.add_paragraph(style=style)
        p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
        p.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.35
        add_inline(p, inline_src)
        for n in nested:
            add_list(doc, n, ordered=(n.tag == "ol"), level=level + 1)


def add_quote(doc, node):
    for child in node.children:
        if child.tag == "p" or child.tag is None:
            p = doc.add_paragraph()
            p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Cm(0.8)
            p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
            p.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.35
            if child.tag is None:
                r = p.add_run(child.text or "")
                set_run_font(r, size=Pt(10), italic=True, color=QUOTE_COLOR)
            else:
                add_inline(p, child, size=Pt(10))
                for r in p.runs:
                    r.font.italic = True
                    r.font.color.rgb = QUOTE_COLOR
        else:
            walk(Node("quote", children=[child]), doc)


def add_code(doc, node):
    code_node = None
    for c in node.children:
        if c.tag == "code":
            code_node = c
            break
    raw = "".join(c.text or "" for c in (code_node or node).children)
    lines = raw.rstrip("\n").split("\n")
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    pf = p.paragraph_format
    pf.left_indent = Cm(0.5)
    pf.space_before = Pt(4)
    pf.space_after = Pt(8)
    pf.line_spacing = 1.15
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if i:
            p.add_run().add_break()
        r = p.add_run(line)
        set_run_font(r, FONT_MONO, FONT_MONO_CJK, size=Pt(8.5))
    # 整段的底纹（段落级）
    ppr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear")
    shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto")
    shd.set(qn("w:fill"), CODE_FILL)
    ppr.append(shd)
    keep_lines(p)


def add_table(doc, node):
    rows = []
    for section in node.children:
        if section.tag in ("thead", "tbody"):
            for tr in section.children:
                if tr.tag != "tr":
                    continue
                cells = [c for c in tr.children if c.tag in ("td", "th")]
                rows.append((cells, all(c.tag == "th" for c in cells)))
        elif section.tag == "tr":
            cells = [c for c in section.children if c.tag in ("td", "th")]
            rows.append((cells, all(c.tag == "th" for c in cells)))
    if not rows:
        return
    ncol = max(len(r[0]) for r in rows)
    table = doc.add_table(rows=0, cols=ncol)
    table.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    table.autofit = True
    table_borders(table)
    for cells, is_head in rows:
        row = table.add_row()
        for j in range(ncol):
            cell = row.cells[j]
            cell.text = ""
            p = cell.paragraphs[0]
            p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(2)
            p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
            p.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.2
            if j < len(cells):
                add_inline(p, cells[j], size=Pt(9.5), base_bold=is_head)
            if is_head:
                cell_shade(cell, TH_FILL)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(4)


def add_hr(doc):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    p.paragraph_format.space_before = Pt(6)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
    para_bottom_border(p)


def walk(node, doc, level=0):
    for child in node.children:
        tag = child.tag
        if tag is None:
            t = (child.text or "").strip()
            if t:
                p = doc.add_paragraph()
                p.paragraph_format.line_spacing = 1.4
                p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(6)
                r = p.add_run(t)
                set_run_font(r, size=Pt(10.5))
            continue
        if tag in ("h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6"):
            add_heading(doc, child, int(tag[1]))
        elif tag == "p":
            add_paragraph(doc, child)
        elif tag == "ul":
            add_list(doc, child, ordered=False, level=level)
        elif tag == "ol":
            add_list(doc, child, ordered=True, level=level)
        elif tag == "table":
            add_table(doc, child)
        elif tag == "pre":
            add_code(doc, child)
        elif tag == "blockquote":
            add_quote(doc, child)
        elif tag == "hr":
            add_hr(doc)
        else:
            walk(child, doc, level)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 主流程

def build(name):
    src = os.path.join(DOCS, name + ".md")
    dst = os.path.join(DOCS, name + ".docx")
    text = open(src, encoding="utf-8").read()
    html = markdown.markdown(text, extensions=["tables", "fenced_code", "sane_lists"])
    dom = Dom()
    dom.feed(html)

    doc = Document()
    sec = doc.sections[0]
    sec.page_width, sec.page_height = Cm(21), Cm(29.7)
    sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Cm(2.2)
    sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Cm(2.2)

    normal = doc.styles["Normal"]
    normal.font.name = FONT_ASCII
    normal.font.size = Pt(10.5)
    normal.element.get_or_add_rPr().get_or_add_rFonts().set(qn("w:eastAsia"), FONT_CJK)

    walk(dom.root, doc)
    doc.save(dst)
    print("  -> %-24s %d 段落 / %d 表格 / %d 字节"
          % (name + ".docx", len(doc.paragraphs), len(doc.tables), os.path.getsize(dst)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    names = sys.argv[1:] or ["技术报告"]
    for n in names:
        build(n)
